title: Running revenue by month
statementMd:
Monthly booking revenue (by departure month) with a cumulative total, both rounded to 2 decimals. Earliest first.

Expected columns: `month`, `revenue`, `cumulative`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Monthly sum in a CTE, then running sum.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', f.depart_date) AS month, SUM(b.fare) AS revenue FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative FROM m ORDER BY month;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
